lines.t: Beloved, I ask you, with the soft loving tone of a father, are you willing to put Me first?
Consider and ask yourselves, do you love Me more than these? …..Do you love Me more than your brothers and sisters?
Do you love Me more than your spouse? Your children? Your family?
Will you give up this life for Me, My sons?
I gave up My life for you, without hesitation….
Now come and partake of Me!….
Taste and see, that The Lord is good!

Yes, your God IS love….And my heart wavers not, nor do I change. And if I love you as you are, why do you not come to Me, so you may receive of My approval, and share in all these gifts which I long to bestow upon you….
Gifts of all kinds, with many words….Words of comfort and healing, of correction and guidance… Understanding which comes by the knowledge of My love.
Therefore My beloveds, draw near and receive…
And you shall surely receive all I offer….
For truly, I was poured out for you…
Are you willing to walk in the same?…
A vessel, set apart, meet for My glory.
